ROW 2447 | note_type=REFERRAL LETTER | author=Lake Armitage MD Larkspur Children's Clinic Dept of General Pediatrics Date: 06/19/2073
Dear Dr. Reyes-Tran,
Re: Miracle Frost, DOB 05/19/2067, 6 years 418 Pargeter Lane, Dunmore, PA 18512 Referral no. REF-2073-0619-A
Thank you for seeing this lovely girl again. - well child visit today, growth on track: wt 21.3 kg, BMI 14.1 - BP 143/90 (repeat was similar, cuff probably too big -- will recheck) - pain 3/10, she points to a lower back tooth on the left - Hgb 12.4, WBC 7.9, no concerns - past: otitis media x2 (most recent 08/2072) - no meds now, NKDA - hx of two prior dental visits (12/2070 and 06/2072), cleaning only
Request: eval of the sore molar, x-ray if needed, cleaning, and fluoride. Mom Justice Frost (570-555-0147) and dad Royal Frost are both keen. Her grandmother, Apple Frost, usually brings her on Thursdays - she is called Mama Apple by everyone, so if the desk says "Apple's here" it is the grandma, not a patient.
Photo attached: Miracle_Frost_horse_drawing.png -- from her teacher Story Finch's email, she wanted you to see she can draw even with the sore tooth, ha. Kind regards,
Lake Armitage, MD Electronically signed 06/19/2073 16:20 cc: Hope Rich RN; chart FC-0482913 Last edited by larmitage from 10.20.4.71
